note: The Bahamas: any non-Bahamian working there for 1 to 90 days needs the Immigration Department's Short Term Work Permit, applied for before arrival; entertainers need a letter of authorisation from the Bahamas Musicians and Entertainers Union or United Artists Bahamas Union, and from 31 December 2025 their applications are due thirty days before the start. Longer work takes the work permit. The Bahamas keeps no CARICOM free movement of skills. No days without a permit.

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department, Short Term Work Permit
sources.said: Any non-Bahamian who desires to work in The Bahamas for a period ranging from 1 to 90 days must apply to the Department of Immigration for a Short Term Work Permit ... Entertainers must have a letter of authorization from The Bahamas Musician & Entertainers Union or United Artists Bahamas Union

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department, Public Notice – Short-term Work Permit Applications Submission (17 December 2025)
sources.said: all short-term work permit applications for entertainers must be submitted at least thirty (30) days prior to the intended start date.
